name: discord-server-status
author: Takaro
description: Post lightweight game-server status to Discord. Includes a Discord !status reply, an optional scheduled Discord status post, and an in-game /serverstatus command. The module reports Takaro-visible server name and online player count/list; host CPU/RAM/process stats require panel/core support and are intentionally not promised here.

discordChannelId.description: Discord channel ID used by the scheduled status cronjob. Discord command replies use the hook channel when this is empty.

discordTriggers.description: Exact Discord messages that trigger a status reply. Matching is case-insensitive after trimming.

includePlayerNames.description: Include online player names in status responses. Disable if you only want counts.

maxPlayerNames.description: Maximum number of online player names to include when includePlayerNames is enabled.

emptyPlayerListText.description: Text for {playerListText} when no players are online.

playerListPrefix.description: Prefix for {playerListText} when players are online.

sendCronWhenEmpty.description: If false, the scheduled Discord status cronjob skips posts when nobody is online. Manual Discord triggers still reply.

updateStatusMessage.description: If true, the scheduled cronjob edits one persistent Discord status message instead of posting a new message every run. If the saved message cannot be edited, the module posts a replacement and stores its ID.

serverstatus.description: Show the current Takaro-visible server status and online player count.
serverstatus.helpText: Usage: /serverstatus — shows server name, online player count, and optionally player names.

discordStatus.description: Reply in Discord when a configured status trigger such as !status is posted.

postDiscordStatus.description: Optionally post the current status to a configured Discord channel.
